title: Absolutely love this subscription, loved the first month, mad about this last one
text:
My niece is 5 years old. So I got her the 5-7 age group STEM. I think the toy was really neat. It was a robot toy, similar to LEGO technic toys, but larger pieces. I thought the instructions were very clear and I felt that it is going to be a great way to teach her to follow instructions. She absolutely loved the toy. She thought it was so neat to make a toy that can move on its own. I’m really excited to see what will be sent next. I definitely recommend this subscription
UPDATE,
Received the 3rd subscription. Was charged for it and was charged $24.99, so I got excited to see what it was and clicked on it and it was being sold on Amazon.com for $18.77. For the same exact item. I contacted Amazon and they told me there was nothing they could do about it. That they "DO NOT HONOR PRICE ADJUSTMENTS". So I returned the product and cancelled this subscription. Why would I want to pay more for a product than what it is being sold for on the same site. This is just ridiculous. Very disappointed in Amazon.
label: negative
